name: Enthalpy v0.4.29
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.29

## Changes

- Sign-in can replace an expired account when macOS Keychain takes longer to
  respond. Saved local files remain on the computer.
- An interrupted sign-out keeps workspace access closed. Sign-in completes
  the remaining credential removal, including after an app restart.
- A rejected session opens Sign in again at once. It no longer appears as an
  empty workspace list until the next session check.
- A failed workspace-list request no longer reports a failed login after the
  account credentials have been accepted and saved.
- Credential storage errors give a more specific cause for the failure.

## Test this preview

Sign in and open a workspace. Sign out, then sign in again. Check that the
correct account and workspace list appear and that your saved notes remain.

## Known limits

Recovery email is not available. After a workspace is restored from Trash,
this preview cannot restore its devices' Sync access. Existing local files
remain available after sign-in. The original OneDrive failure still needs
further testing.
